notes: Latest line per (source, model) across the 8 probe files wins in timestamp order; live-20261006.json classification replica (.inputs/classify-live-20261006.js) informed the status mapping but final statuses use this file's rule.

9router candidate identity follows candidates.jsonl direct-http rows: harness direct-http, accessPath 9router, gateway 9router, upstream = first id segment (combo when unprefixed), accountId ninerouter, quotaScope UNKNOWN. Direct sources use harness direct-http, accessPath direct, empty gateway, upstream = source; bai#N probes keep the per-credential accountId; opencode-builtin uses harness opencode.

tools/ai-brain/data/evidence/evidence.json is absent in this worktree; cooldown entries copy the schema named in the task plus the evidence.js recordProbe fields (lastStatus, blockedAt, blockReason, cause, scope, cooldownMs, resetTime, humanAction).

resetAt = observedAt + parseResetTime(detail) using the Controller's parseResetTime; cooldownMs falls back to Controller defaults (quota_exhausted 3600000, upstream_rate_limit 300000) when no reset text exists.
Quota scope is upstream except bai#N per-credential probes, which are account scope per the Controller failure-domain rule (failure names the credential).
The probe did not capture rate-limit headers, so quota.remaining is UNKNOWN for every candidate.
bai HTTP 429s and several 9router/llmtr 429s carry no reset text; their resetTime is null and cooldownMs is the Controller default.

Router aliases (kr/*, gh/*, cl/*, ocz/*, thegrid *-latest/code-*/agent-*/text-*, copilot-*) are unmapped to canonical ids; benchmark is null for them.
No key material was read or written; details/request ids are not copied into this file (resetText carries only the reset phrase).
